items.q: What if I don't know my exact time of birth?
items.a: We'll cast the chart for noon. The positions of the Sun, planets and most aspects stay accurate, but we can't calculate houses and the Ascendant — those sections are skipped. The time is often on your birth certificate or hospital records.

items.q: How is this different from a horoscope?
items.a: A horoscope describes one twelfth of humanity by Sun sign. A birth chart is the position of ten planets, the Ascendant and houses at the moment you were born, and the angles between them. Two people with the same sign get two different texts from us.

The planetary positions are computed by software from astronomical ephemerides, to within an arcminute. The text is composed by a language model following a method written by Chronika's astrologers; every paragraph is tied to a specific position or aspect in your chart.

items.q: How do you store my data?
items.a: Your date, time and place of birth are stored only to build your documents and are deleted after 30 days. We don't share them with third parties.

The eleventh house makes friends and partners neighbouring categories: many of your relationships started as friendships, and that is a method, not an accident.

body: The fastest reaction in your chart. When something important is touched, the body answers before the thought does. That gives you courage — and a few words you later regret.
What to do with it: redirect rather than suppress. Physical action in the first minutes takes the initial impulse and leaves clarity.

honest.title: Honestly, about how this is made

items.title: The calculation is exact
items.text: Planetary positions and transit dates are computed by software from the Swiss Ephemeris — the astronomical tables professional astrology programs run on. Nothing is invented: every position can be checked against any astrological calculator.

items.title: The text is written by AI
items.text: It does not tire on the thirtieth page and does not write filler: it follows a method written by Chronika's astrologers, and every paragraph is tied to a specific position or aspect of your chart — which you can see in the text.

items.title: We do not predict events
items.text: No wedding dates, no verdicts. A chart shows periods and tendencies; the decisions are yours.

honest.note: Astrology is not a science. It is a language that makes it convenient to think about yourself and your time.

items.q: How is this different from a horoscope?
items.a: A horoscope writes the same thing for everyone of one sign. A birth chart is the position of every planet, the Ascendant and the houses at the moment you were born. A chart like that repeats once in several thousand years.

items.q: What does “forecast” mean? Do you predict events?
items.a: No. We show when the moving planets touch your chart and which themes come to the front in those periods: work, relationships, home. How exactly it shows up is up to you.

items.q: I want to know which country to live in. Will the reading answer that?
items.a: No, choosing a country is a separate technique. But the reading does show what home and footing mean for you and which periods of {from}–{year} suit big changes.

items.q: I do not live where I was born. Does that matter?
items.a: No. The chart is built from your place of birth, and the forecast periods apply wherever you live.

items.q: I do not know my exact birth time.
items.a: We build the chart for noon. The planets and most aspects stay exact, but without houses and the Ascendant part of the reading is shorter. The time is often on your birth certificate.

The calculation is done by software from the Swiss Ephemeris; the text by a language model following a method written by Chronika's astrologers. Every paragraph rests on a specific position or aspect of your chart.
No. One payment, one document. No recurring charges.

items.q: What if I do not like it?
items.a: Read the free preview first: the full reading is written in the same voice. If there is an error in the calculation, write to help@chronika.me and we will fix it or refund you.

items.q: Can I give it as a gift?
items.a: Yes. Enter their birth data and your own email, then forward them the PDF.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: We use your date, time and place of birth only for your document and pass them only to the services it cannot be made without: calculation, text generation, payment. We delete them after 30 days, or on request.
